name: web-two-tab-segmented-switch-with-profile-and-notifications-content
title: Two-tab segmented control with a raised white active pill and a content line 'Content for Profile'
whatItIs: A white frame with a grey rounded track split into Profile (active, white raised pill with a person icon) and Notifications (bell icon, grey text) and a grey line of content below.
whatItMeans: Simple and clear; the raised pill shows selection with almost no ink.
techniques: Split a track into two equal segments.
Raise the active one as a white pill.

vocabulary.definition: A track of two or more exclusive options.
The selected segment shown as a raised capsule.
The content area shown for the selected tab.
The recessed background behind the segments.
